resources.title: Data Pipeline Explained: The Warehouse Analogy
resources.description: A one-page diagram walking the full modern data pipeline — S3 as the loading dock, Spark/Databricks as the processing area, a warehouse as the organized storage shelves, and Power BI/SQL as the analysts querying it — with a glossary of bucket, object, prefix, stage, and table.

resources.title: Databricks Medallion Architecture
resources.description: Bronze/Silver/Gold layer reference diagram showing what each layer holds, who uses it, and why the medallion pattern exists — data quality, auditability, reusability, scalability, and governance. Built on Databricks, but the same bronze/silver/gold pattern applies directly to S3 + Glue + Athena/Redshift.

resources.title: The Amazon Fulfillment Center Analogy for Spark
resources.description: A full-page reference on how Spark actually executes a job — clusters, executors, partitions, the DAG, narrow vs. wide transformations, joins (shuffle vs. broadcast), caching, repartition vs. coalesce, actions, and reading the Spark UI. Directly relevant to Spark on EMR/Glue.

resources.title: Why S3 Still Matters Even After Data Is in the Warehouse
resources.description: Explains why raw files stay in S3 even after they've been loaded into Redshift/Athena — reprocessing, audit/compliance, lineage, replay for new systems, and cost — with the full pipeline shown end to end.
